Text to Video Hindi AI — Initial release

- Instantly convert Hindi text into short AI-generated videos with voiceover and visuals.
- Supports TXT, DOCX, PDF, and SRT file uploads up to 200MB.
- Automatic connection to cloud video creation backend on first use.
- Simple, guided workflows for generating, exporting, and editing Hindi language videos.
- Designed for Hindi content creators needing quick, high-quality video output without filming or recording.
